Team —

- Flag exceptions that require legal/procurement or SLA concessions and add a short rationale.
- For product/infra asks, note the minimum acceptable SLO and suggested mitigation (canary/fallback).

I'll also invite the necessary execs if there are items flagged as "requires exec decision".

Thanks —

Marissa — replying inline.

> Outstanding product clarification needed on the "regional quantization" timeline (Mar vs. Oct was the last verbal).

We had two parallel signals: research prototype by Mar, but production canary by Oct. I can own a limited canary (APAC US-east subset) that would be safe for Acme's non-critical traffic by mid-September.

Plan and fallbacks: 
- Canary: mid-Sept rollout; 10% traffic slice; 48hr rollback window.
- If Acme needs earlier, we can pin them to the legacy FP16 variant for the QBR period and then schedule migration in the Oct window.

SLO ask: what SLO are we promising for the legacy vs quantized variant during the QBR pilot? I need target p95 latency and token cost target to recommend tiering.

Related runbook link: https://drive.redwood.com/runbooks/quantization-canary (internal)

I'll update the workbook with the canary plan row and mark myself as owner.

—Karthik
Principal Product Manager, Inference
